notes: Blackened steel, 0.149 kg. End chamfer: 1 mm axial run at 30 degrees to the axis, 0.577 mm normal setback; vertical corners softened 0.3 mm. One six-sided collision prism. Metres, Z up, front -X, bottom-centre origin; all transforms applied. Triangulated visual OBJ with normals and a nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlas. Albedo is CPU Cycles 64-sample DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), saved as 8-bit sRGB; no direct illumination or highlights. Procedural Principled PBR retained in source.blend. Preview: CPU Cycles 64, 1024 square, neutral grey and three lights, front-left above. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
